text: dsh-tool-read-tiff 是面向 DSH Web 的 TIFF 图像读取工具，可接收本地文件路径或 HTTP(S) 地址，逐页解码 TIFF 并生成可预览 PNG，同时返回尺寸、页数、压缩方式、色彩与位深等元数据。配置兼容视觉服务后，还能按提示返回图像文字描述；未配置时仍可完成转换并交由 describe_image 继续识别。适合处理扫描件、多页传真、地图和科学图像；视觉描述需要自行配置端点、模型和凭据。

dsh-tool-read-tiff reads TIFF files in DSH web. It converts a chosen page from a local file or URL to PNG and reports image metadata. An optional vision endpoint can describe the image; without it, pass the PNG to describe_image.
想让 DSH 读取 TIFF 扫描件并提取其中的文字。
需要查看多页 TIFF 的指定页面和图像属性。
有没有工具能把本地 TIF 转成可预览的 PNG？
让 DSH 读取地图或科学 TIFF，并告诉我尺寸、色彩和位深。
我有一个 TIFF 文件或网页地址，想逐页查看内容。
没有视觉模型时，也希望先把 TIFF 解码并生成图片。
I need DSH to inspect a scanned TIFF and transcribe its text.
Can I convert a local TIF into a previewable PNG and inspect its metadata?
dsh-tool-read-tiff 的功能「TIFF 解码与元数据」：read_tiff 接收本地 TIFF 文件或 HTTP(S) 地址，解码指定页并返回尺寸、页数、压缩、色彩、位深和字节序等信息。调用者可用 page 选择零起始页。
dsh-tool-read-tiff 的功能「转换为 PNG」：每次调用将选中的 TIFF 页面转换成 PNG，输出路径随结果返回；本地来源写到原文件旁，网络来源写入配置目录或系统临时目录。
dsh-tool-read-tiff 的功能「视觉模型描述」：配置视觉服务后，工具按 prompt 将解码后的 PNG 发送至兼容 Chat Completions 的模型，并将返回文字及模型名放入结果。
dsh-tool-read-tiff 的功能「离线转换交接」：未配置视觉端点时，工具仍返回解码结果和 PNG 路径，并提示后续可调用 describe_image 查看图像内容。

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · dsh-tool-read-tiff — TIFF Reading Tool Plugin：Model-facing `read_tiff` tool: gives **text-only models** (DeepSeek V4 etc.) the ability to read
TIFF/TIF images — the format plain vision pipelines and browsers cannot touch. Each call loads one
TIFF (a local file path or an http(s) URL), decodes a page into a **viewable PNG**, and reports the
full header metadata (dimensions, page count, compression, photometric interpretation, per-channel
bit depths, byte order). When a vision endpoint is configured it also asks an OpenAI-compatible
vision model to describe the decoded page; **only text and metadata enter the conversation, the
TIFF and PNG bytes never enter the session log**.

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · dsh-tool-read-tiff — TIFF Reading Tool Plugin：Decoding is done by [sharp](https://sharp.pixelplumbing.com) (libvips + libtiff), so the common
real-world TIFF variants work out of the box: classic and BigTIFF, multi-page, LZW / Deflate /
PackBits / CCITT Group 3 & 4 / JPEG compression, bilevel (1-bit), 8/16-bit, and float samples.

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Capabilities：| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Two inputs | Local absolute path, or an http(s) URL (redirects refused) |
| Decode + convert | Decodes the requested page to a PNG written beside the source (or under `outputDir` / the OS temp dir for URLs); the path comes back in `convertedPath` so the conversation can preview it |
| Full header metadata | `width` / `height` / `pages` / `page` / `channels` / `depth` / `space` / `density`, plus the TIFF-specific facts: `compression` (lzw, deflate, ccitt-group4, jpeg, none, …), `photometric` (rgb, black-is-zero, cmyk, …), `bitsPerSample`, `samplesPerPixel`, `byteOrder`, `variant` (classic / bigtiff) |
| Multi-page | `page` is a zero-based page index; `pages` reports the total count, so the model can iterate a multi-page fax / scan |
| Optional vision | When `baseURL` + `model` are configured, the decoded PNG is sent to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Chat Completions) and the answer comes back as `text`; the `prompt` argument carries your precise instruction |
| Compose without config | With no endpoint configured the tool still decodes + converts + reports metadata and returns a `note` directing th

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Security model：- Vision requests and URL downloads both refuse HTTP redirects (`redirect: 'error'`); bearer
  credentials and image bytes never reach a source other than the configured deployment.
- The vision request body carries the base64 PNG but no key; request headers and resolved
  credentials are not logged.
- Only `http(s)` URLs and local paths are accepted; every other URL scheme is rejected.
- Response bodies are capped before parsing; error excerpts are bounded (200 chars).
- The TIFF and PNG bytes are never returned into the conversation — only text and metadata.

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Installation：The plugin is a standard cordis bundle. Install it into the web profile from GitHub (the `prepare`
script builds on install; allow `sharp` under `allowBuilds` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` if prompted):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/fulander0301/dsh-tool-read-tiff.git
```

or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-tool-read-tiff
```

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Installation：Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle declares `sharp` and `schemastery` as runtime
dependencies; `@deepseek-ai/*` peer services resolve from the dsh installation, exactly like the
other dsh-web-ui tool plugins.

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Configuration：The tool works with **zero configuration** (decode + convert + metadata only). To enable the
one-shot visual description, configure the vision endpoint (Settings → 插件配置 → "TIFF reading",
or a composition entry):

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseURL` | — | OpenAI-compatible endpoint root (e.g. `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`); trailing slashes stripped |
| `model` | — | Vision model id |
| `apiKey` | — | Inline key; prefer `apiKeyEnv` |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `VISION_API_KEY` | Environment-variable name for the API key (shared convention with the describe-image tool) |
| `defaultPrompt` | see source | Instruction used when a call omits its `prompt` |
| `maxBytes` | `67108864` | TIFF byte bound (local files and downloads alike) |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `1024` | Output-token cap sent to the vision model |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Per-call vision request timeout |
| `outputDir` | — (temp dir for URLs) | Where converted PNGs go when the source is not a local file |

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Configuration：Configured mount example (`cordis.patch.yml` / composition file):

```yaml
- id: read-tiff
  name: 'dsh-tool-read-tiff'
  config:
    baseURL: https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Usage：Point the tool at a TIFF and (optionally) give the vision model a precise instruction:

- "transcribe all text in this scanned fax"
- "extract the table as CSV"
- "describe the map features and projection"
- "what does the label in the corner say"

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Usage：For multi-page files, call again with `page: 1`, `page: 2`, and so on; `pages` tells you how many
there are. When no vision endpoint is configured, the tool still returns everything it decoded plus
a `convertedPath` you can hand to the already-installed `describe_image` tool.

dsh-tool-read-tiff README · Known limitations：- One page per call: multi-page TIFFs are read one page at a time via `page`.
- Very large or exotic TIFFs (complex float multi-band scientific rasters) may need pre-processing;
  the tool reports sharp's error with a clear message when a page cannot be decoded.
- The optional vision step speaks only the Chat Completions protocol.
